transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. Can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Well, what finally pushed me to come in is I keep having trouble really taking in what people are saying. Like my wife will be telling me about my cousin’s appointments or who needs a ride, and I’m looking right at her, but then a minute later I realize I didn’t actually catch half of it. It’s been frustrating.
Has this trouble taking in what people say been a new change for you recently, or is it something you've noticed on and off since you were younger?

No, it’s not really new. Looking back, it was there when I was a kid too. Even in grade school, before I was 12, teachers would tell my parents I was bright, but I was always daydreaming. I’d leave homework in my desk or need reminders to finish classwork. So it’s kind of been on and off for a long time.
Do you also notice yourself feeling excessively worried or on edge much of the time, separate from these attention lapses?
Not really, no. I mean, I worry about normal things sometimes, but I wouldn’t say I’m on edge most of the time or anything like that.
Over the past few weeks, have you noticed feeling down, sad, or losing interest in things you normally enjoy?
No, I haven’t really noticed that. My mood’s been pretty normal, and I still enjoy the usual things.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or have trouble sitting still, or find yourself acting impulsively, like interrupting others or blurting things out?

I don’t think so, not in a big way. I’m not usually restless or fidgeting all the time, and I don’t think I’m especially impulsive or interrupting people much. At least, it’s not something I’ve really noticed.
Would you say these attention difficulties are currently causing real problems for you both at work and at home, or mainly in just one of those areas?

It’s kind of both, I’d say. At home it’s been causing some tension because my wife feels like she can’t always count on me with helping take care of my cousin. And with the catering stuff, I’ve had to double-check myself or redo small tasks so things don’t get mixed up. So it’s not huge, but it is causing some real problems.
